How many valence electrons does a nitrog:

What is the name for the lowest whole-nu:

What is the formula of magnesium oxide?\:

When does an ionic compound such as NaCl:

What is the mass of 2.00 mol of NaCl? (M:

Which compound should have the highest m:

Why is an ionic crystal brittle?\nA shif:

What is a covalent bond?\nA shared pair:

How many electrons are shared in a tripl:
